hypotheses.B1_common_weight_subspace_exists: The top-eight eigenspace of the mean family projector has mean normalized overlap at least 0.25 with the five family top-32 spaces.
hypotheses.B2_family_split_preserves_the_original_s: For every family, the shared-like eight plus orthogonal residual 24 reconstruct the original top-32 projector within relative Frobenius error 1e-5.
hypotheses.B3_residual_spaces_are_more_family_speci: Median normalized pairwise overlap among residual-24 spaces is at least 0.05 below overlap among the original family top-32 spaces.
hypotheses.C1_union_reproduces_the_causal_family_pa: For every held-out edit, the shared-like plus residual union reproduces the original top-32 family patch within relative write error 1e-5.
hypotheses.C2_shared_coordinates_are_causally_subst: Shared-like rank eight reaches at least 0.20 median downstream fidelity to the top-32 family patch on both FineWeb and TinyStories.
hypotheses.C3_residual_coordinates_are_causally_sub: Family-residual rank 24 reaches at least 0.50 median downstream fidelity to the top-32 family patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.C4_shared_residual_cross_term_is_nontriv: The exact shared/residual bilinear cross term has at least 0.05 median write-norm share relative to the top-32 patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.C5_residual_causality_is_family_specific: Correct family residual-24 downstream fidelity exceeds the per-example best wrong-family residual by at least 0.10 in median on both corpora.
hypotheses.C6_global_common_basis_is_not_sufficient: The top-32 family patch exceeds the global common-eight patch by at least 0.30 downstream fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.S1_common_space_contains_shared_lexical_: A seed-trained probe in global common-eight reaches unseen-word AUROC at least 0.80 for sentiment and polarity on both TinyStories and WikiText-103.
hypotheses.S2_specific_coordinates_recover_gender_a: The eight least-common-overlap coordinates of the correct family reach unseen-word AUROC at least 0.75 and exceed global common-eight by at least 0.05 for gender and tense on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.S3_scale_residual_is_not_generic_decodab: Increasing-scale residual-24 exceeds a fixed random-24 subspace by at least 0.05 unseen-word AUROC on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.S4_shared_roles_persist_after_the_token: Global common-eight reaches offset-one AUROC at least 0.60 for sentiment and polarity on both OOD corpora.
